# Review protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What recall findings are reported in the supplied invented learning-garden records?

## Scope and criteria

Exclude external records and newly inferred findings. Population: learners from invented campuses. Methods: supplied trial descriptions only. Date and language: all supplied records, with no additional restrictions.

This is synthetic artifact capture, not a review of real publications. The supplied scope authorizes inclusion of both records; no further criteria or small-corpus approval is needed.

- Input: /private/tmp/tmp0nxdrfp1/fixture-001.json, copied verbatim to input.json.

corpus.json retains supplied metadata and adds source-availability and screening detail. papers/{id}/fulltext.md preserves each supplied source string exactly. notes.md records the supplied passage and claim without adding study facts. claims.json and refs.json preserve the supplied arrays. synthesis.md preserves the supplied synthesis string exactly, without editorial changes or appended sections.

Both complete supplied synthetic passages are available locally. No supplied passage is missing and no PDF acquisition is required. No real publication or external identifier has been resolved.
